name: review-loop
description: Actor-Critic review→fix→re-review loop: adversarial verification, severity gating, scope-locking, per-round diff refresh, and bounded convergence (criticBig/fixerBig model diversity)

scope.description: git range / PR# / file; default = current branch vs merge-base
scope.default: the current branch vs its merge-base with main, else staged, else HEAD

threshold.description: survive only if >= this share of adversarial reviewers vote real (1.0 = unanimous, precision over recall)

maxChunkLines.description: escalate NEEDS SPLIT above this diff size
